scope: Generated README checklist percentage and SVG, local pre-commit installation and staged-only updates

verification.realGitCommitTest: Staged ledger remains at 1/2 and unstaged ledger at 2/2; README body edits retain their staged/unstaged state; committed and working SVG match their corresponding ledger.

limits: Checklist count includes management and verification tooling; not a weighted feature or behavior percentage. Hooks run for checkouts that install them; parity:check rejects stale generated files.
